You are fixing a harness bug on freytag-forge. Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. Edit ONLY scripts/ringer/stage7/three_c_probe.py and scripts/ringer/stage7/test_three_c_probe.py. Never touch data/, src/, git state, .env. NO network or billed call. Use `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp` and `.venv/bin/python`.

BUG: a live smoke of three_c_probe.py died at the first engine turn with "'RuntimeSnapshot' object has no attribute 'package'" (the CLI wrote run-failure.txt and an empty rows.json). In run_row, `before = state.snapshot()` returns a RuntimeSnapshot (src/storygame/runtime/state.py:64), but the code then calls _fact_keys(before) and probably other helpers (_staged_cue uses state.package) with it; snapshots have no .facts/.package. Read run_row end to end and fix EVERY place a snapshot or other wrong object is used where the live RuntimeState is needed (compute before-facts from the live state BEFORE the turn, e.g. before_facts = _fact_keys(state); keep the snapshot only for restore_snapshot). Also verify record fields that read engine data after the turn (committed reveals, deadline_event_ids from the turn record, story_complete, staged cue) against the real RuntimeEngine/TurnRecord API by reading src/storygame/runtime/engine.py; fix wrong attribute names.

Then make the existing hermetic tests catch this class of bug: add a test that runs run_row (or the loop it uses) against a REAL RuntimeEngine built via bench.core.package_and_state(load_variation(bench/variations/stage7-3c-control.json), '3C') with a fake scripted provider injected (no Cloudflare) and a fake ask function returning commands like 'Send the evidence package.', for at least 3 attempts, asserting rows contain real status, before/after fact deltas and committed reveals fields without exceptions. If run_row calls provider_for/counted_provider in a way that blocks injecting a fake provider, refactor minimally (e.g. an optional provider_factory parameter defaulting to current behaviour). Also make the CLI write completed rows to rows.json incrementally (after each row) so a later failure keeps earlier rows.

Finish with: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q scripts/ringer/stage7/test_three_c_probe.py`, `.venv/bin/ruff format` and `.venv/bin/ruff check` on both files, and `.venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/stage7/three_c_probe.py --n 1 --dry-run --out /tmp/3c-dry-fix1`.
